name: Compression Scanner Grok bot
tagline: Flags tightening ranges across three timeframes, with breakout and invalidation levels
description: A chart watcher for one pattern: ranges squeezing tight before a move. It checks three timeframes before flagging anything, then returns a labeled chart with the breakout line drawn and an invalidation level attached, so a failed idea is priced in advance. Moves called off a wick alone are explicitly refused.
author: rightwingink1
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
